   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  JULY 21, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:15 p.m. Responding to roll call were Chair Leon, Vice Chair
Ang, and Commissioner Garcia. Commissioner Sanchez was absent. Also present was Alex
Ocegueda, Office Assistant III and Jocelyn Hernandez, Communications Specialist.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Vice Chair Ang made the motion and Commissioner Garcia seconded to approve the minutes for June
9, 2025. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Vision and Mission Statements

Mrs. Ocegueda explained that liaisons have been asked to collaborate with their commissioners to
establish both Vision and Mission statements for their commission. Mrs. Ocegueda read some
suggestions from Communications Director Levy Sun. Commissioners asked Mrs. Ocegueda to
combine two of three statements read but would like to incorporate in the statement that the commission
is also engaging neighboring communities. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will work with Mr. Sun on fusing
the two statements.

Commissioner Appreciation Dinner

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners for their feedback on the event. All commissioners stated the
feedback they received from attendees was positive. Chair Leon suggested that when ordering the
party favors, keep the personalization generic so any leftovers can be used as giveaways/prizes/gifts
at other events the commission would need to be present for. Mrs. Ocegueda confirmed with the
Commission that next year’s event will take place on Friday, June 12, 2026 and all agreed they would
like to continue with the same room and set up for next year.

First Responders Luncheon

Mrs. Ocegueda informed Commissioners that City Council requested a date change for this event;
originally scheduled for October 1st, the event will now take place on Wednesday, October 22, 2025 to
accommodate the attendance of City Council members. Chair Leon stated she would need to check
her work calendar to see if she’s available that date. All other commissioners confirmed no issues with
the date change. Mrs. Ocegueda asked commissioners if they wished to continue with the Red, White,
and Blue color scheme for the event; all agreed to continue with it.

Business Spotlight

Mrs. Ocegueda showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the June Donut Spots edition video to
Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners for their input on spotlight themes for next year
as she is beginning to compile the list. Vice Chair Ang suggested Family Entertainment spots referring

to Chuck E. Cheese, Jumper Jungle, AMC and Milagro theatres as possible candidates. Vice Chair
Ang also suggested car dealerships. Commissioner Garcia suggested Chinese Food spots. Chair Leon
suggested hair salons, tax services and non-profit organizations.

New Social Media Series

Mrs. Ocegueda reported that staff is currently working on a series name and logo. She also informed
Commissioners that staff paid a visit to the Sproul Museum and saw there was a lot of material that
could be used for the history portion of the series; it would just take time to pick a particular topic and
find the relative information to create a video. Vice Chair Ang would like the city to eventually provide
virtual tours of these historical locations and digitization of printed/written material as he worries that if
any type of disaster were to occur the city would lose valuable material. Chair Leon suggested meeting
with the Historical Society Commission to possibly collaborate/assist on preserving and promoting
Norwalk’s history. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will reach out to the Historical Society Commission
Liaison to see which meeting they can attend.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Hernandez provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda updated Commissioners on their merchandise survey outreach. Mrs. Ocegueda asked
Commissioners how the profits from the sales of merchandise would be utilized. After some discussion,
Commissioners are considering the following on how to utilize the funds: to replenish merchandise, art
contest scholarship/award, and add funds to their budget to plan for new city events.

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Chair Leon stated that she attended the Norwalk Park Development Meeting, heard a lot of feedback
from the community members and the plans show some good ideas for the design of the park.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:20 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
